annotations.title: List a workflow's steps and who does them

description: Every step in a WORKFLOW page's steps diagram, in diagram order, with its phase, whether it is itself a workflow (subWorkflowPageId), and who the map says owns, does, approves, is consulted on, or doesn't do it, and `uses`: the systems or documents it's done in. `unknown: true` means nothing that counts says who does the step or what it's done in — those are the questions worth asking in an interview. A step with `uses` and nobody on it is one a system runs; don't ask who does it. `disputed` lists roles or people with conflicting claims; ask about those rather than picking a side. `proposals` counts claims waiting for review. `variants` are named subsets of the steps ("rush job", "enterprise client"); each step lists the variants it belongs to. Returns no steps when the workflow has no diagram yet (compass_process_diagram_ensure makes one).

workspace.description: Workspace slug. Personal tokens with no default workspace MUST pass this; tokens with a default can override per call. Ignored for workspace API keys.
